tasks.subject: Task 1: hub accessor + sse_clients in API
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Hub.Clients() exists and the metrics response carries the connection count.

**Files:**
- Modify: internal/hub/hub.go + hub_test.go
- Modify: internal/api/metrics.go + metrics_test.go + server.go

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Clients(): empty 0; register 2 -> 2; unregister 1 -> 1
- [ ] top-level sse_clients equals stub value 3

**Verify:** cd backend && go test ./internal/hub/ ./internal/api/ -count=1 -v -> all PASS
